description: Prepares a booking without creating it: re-checks the slot against live capacity and the basket against the centre, then returns bookingUrl — a washlib.com link that opens the booking form at the contact step with the centre, day, slot, vehicle and services pre-filled — with arrival times and the online / on-site totals. The booking exists only once the customer confirms their phone by SMS and pays, or chooses on-site payment, on Washlib. bookingUrl works only exactly as returned: an altered link loses the pre-fill.

centerSlug.description: Centre slug as returned by find_centers or search_available_slots

serviceIds.description: The basket quote_booking priced: one formule, plus options

vehicleType.description: vehicleTypes.value from get_center_details (s, m, l, xl, moto) — never the label.
